_comment: Mutation testing: npm run mutation. Changes the app's code in small ways and checks a test fails each time. Report: reports/mutation/mutation.html
_comment_tsconfig: Stryker rewrites tsconfig paths for its sandbox with TypeScript's JS API, which TypeScript 7 no longer has. This app's tsconfigs only refer to files inside this folder, which the sandbox copies whole, so the rewrite is skipped by naming a file that does not exist.
